messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Neon Pairs is implemented. Open the self-contained [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html) to play offline.

The game includes board codes, snapshot export and import, saved preferences and best scores, keyboard controls, and the replay CLI. The pure game rules and browser session are separated as specified.

Verification passed: the locked install, type checking and build, five unit tests, and four browser journeys. The browser tests included opening the built file with network requests blocked. No screen reader was used; spoken-output confirmation remains for user acceptance.
